core_competencies.name: Merchant-centered product judgment
core_competencies.description: Frames product and engineering decisions around merchant jobs-to-be-done, entrepreneur outcomes, and measurable commerce impact.

core_competencies.name: Builder ownership and shipping discipline
core_competencies.description: Shows direct responsibility for scoping, building, launching, learning, and improving useful product or platform work.

core_competencies.name: Tradeoff reasoning under ambiguity
core_competencies.description: Explains technical, product, merchant, and operational tradeoffs without hiding assumptions or slowing down unnecessarily.

core_competencies.name: Learning loop after launch
core_competencies.description: Uses feedback, metrics, incidents, merchant behavior, or adoption signals to improve the shipped system.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Defines the merchant or entrepreneur problem, the affected workflow, and the expected outcome before describing the solution.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Talks about ecommerce, platform work, or technical complexity without naming the merchant impact.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: Which merchant behavior or business outcome would prove this product decision worked?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Shows a concrete shipped artifact, personal ownership, launch constraints, and post-launch learning.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Describes planning, meetings, or ideas without evidence that useful work shipped.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What did you personally ship, and what changed after it reached users?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Compares alternatives across user value, technical risk, maintainability, speed, and business impact.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Presents one solution as obvious without discussing constraints or discarded options.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What tradeoff would make you choose a simpler solution first?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Names uncertainty, gathers feedback, adjusts the plan, and keeps momentum without overclaiming certainty.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Treats ambiguity as a blocker or gives a polished answer with no learning loop.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What signal would tell you to change direction after launch?

honest_limits: This overlay is a lightweight public-source draft based on official public Shopify lens evidence.
It should be used for product and engineering practice prompts only, not as an official hiring rubric.
It needs more public interview-pattern validation before promotion beyond draft status.
